# DeadRecall

DeadRecall is the unified, exact-version distribution of the Totem ecosystem for Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric. Install this single JAR to receive the tested module set without manually matching module versions.

## Highlights

- Tiered backpacks, upgrades, inventory integration, and death recovery
- Copper-golem automation and storage routing
- Alchemy, enchanting, excavation, and vanilla-friendly utility systems
- Lodestone travel, social features, and death-node recovery through TotemNexus
- Villager production, gathering, crafting, fishing, and emerald-based economic cycles
- Compatibility migrations for legacy DeadRecall and Totem worlds

## Included modules

TotemCore, TotemRemnant, TotemDiscordBridge, TotemAutomata, TotemAlchemy, TotemEnchanting, TotemExcavation, TotemVanillaTweaks, TotemNexus, and TotemVillagers.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API
- Java 25

DeadRecall is required on both the client and server. Trinkets Updated is supported as an optional integration.

## 中文說明

DeadRecall 是 Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric 的 Totem 系列整合發行版。單一 JAR 已內含經過鎖版測試的背包、死亡回收、自動化、煉金、附魔、挖掘、傳送與村民經濟模組，不需要另外手動配對各模組版本。

Source code and issue tracking are available through the links on this project page.
